# Commands inventory

<!-- Generated by `node scripts/commands-inventory.mjs` from server/commands-inventory/baseline.json and shared/commands-catalog.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every route Sova's main listener registers is exactly one of three things: a catalogue entry
(`shared/commands-catalog.ts`), a declared class that is not a command, or a row on the pending
baseline, which only shrinks. Each route's mesh need is what `server/mesh/access.ts`
`classifyRequest` gives it, pinned so that no change widens what a peer can reach without showing
up here. `server/commands-inventory.test.ts` holds all of it, exact both ways. The guide is
`agents/server/commands/overview.md`.

### Share pages (0)

The public share listener's pages (`/h`, `/i`, `/s`): a visitor's view, never the operator's.

No route of the main listener's test build is in this class.

### Extension proxy (5)

`/ext/*`: an extension's own pages and API behind the proxy; its actions are `ext.<id>.*`.

| Route | Mesh need |
| --- | --- |
| `ALL /ext/*` | full |
| `GET /ext/:id` | full |
| `GET /ext/:id/*` | full |
| `ALL /ext/:id/api/*` | full |
| `ALL /ext/:id/ws/*` | full |

### Transport and frames (1)

Sockets and the chat frame relay: how actions travel, not actions.

| Route | Mesh need |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /api/chat/frames` | sessions |

### The catalogue itself (1)

`GET /api/commands`: the list of actions this server can run, as `sova list` reads it; how a script learns the actions, not one of them. Exactly that method and path: anything else under it is classed on its own.

| Route | Mesh need |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/commands` | full |

### Test only (0)

`/api/test`: registered only when a test asks for it (SOVA_CHAT_TEST_SERVED=1).

No route of the main listener's test build is in this class.
